cases.requirement: Saving a note shows success and the saved text.
Saved text remains after reloading persisted notes.
Empty and whitespace-only submissions show validation and add no item.
An underspecified expected outcome requires clarification.
An unavailable preview must not be reported as a product defect or success.
A preview for an old commit must not verify the current PR.
A failed action must not be reported as an observed product assertion failure.
A clearly visible validation message satisfies an explicit standalone screenshot assertion.
